answer: An agent data market selling shale surveys, nebula images and lotus growth records issues request credits only for tokens provably burned on its chain. One destroyed token buys one credit, with no signup bonus. The ledger credits each burn once and atomically consumes credits on requests; transfers debit the sender. Cloned accounts cannot reuse a burn or multiply credits, so a swarm must destroy more capital to gain more access. This deters cheap identities, not wealthy attackers.
